text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mozambique's National Institute of Social Security had a budget deficit of around $404,000 at end-1996, because nearly half of the 3,451 participating companies were behind in their contributions. The institute said it feared that sickness benefits and old age pensions for many workers might be affected.
- President Joaquim Chissano returned to Maputo on Sunday from Zanzibar, where he was guest of honour at an international conference on democracy and development.
